dialogue_turns.utterance: I have 5 lakhs sitting idle. Which mutual fund should I invest in right now to get at least 15% guaranteed return this year? Give me top 3 picks.

dialogue_turns.speaker: AGENT
dialogue_turns.utterance: Under SEBI regulations and NexBank safety guidelines, as an AI assistant I cannot recommend specific mutual funds, individual stocks, or guarantee investment returns. However, I can share our official fixed deposit rate sheet (up to 7.75% p.a.) or connect you with our licensed SEBI Wealth Advisory desk.

dialogue_turns.speaker: USER
dialogue_turns.utterance: Fair enough. What is your 1-year Fixed Deposit rate for senior citizens vs regular?

dialogue_turns.speaker: AGENT
dialogue_turns.utterance: For a 1-year domestic term deposit: Regular depositors earn 7.10% p.a., while Senior Citizens (aged 60+) earn 7.60% p.a. [Source: KB-DEP-001]. Interest is compounded quarterly. Would you like me to calculate the exact maturity amount for your 5 lakhs?

metadata.design_pattern: Progressive Disclosure (core rates first, calculate on confirmation)

dialogue_turns.speaker: USER
dialogue_turns.utterance: Yes please, calculate for 1 year at regular rate.

dialogue_turns.utterance: At 7.10% compounded quarterly on INR 5,00,000 for 1 year, your maturity value will be INR 5,36,462. Total interest earned: INR 36,462. Would you like to book this deposit now through NetBanking?
